summary: Clarify NDVI-assisted LST requirement and Sentinel-1 scope
details: User reaffirms optional use of NDVI within temperature derivation, not just a separate emissivity raster, and asks whether Sentinel-1 exists/is useful. Source inspection: current workflow uses official L2 ST only; NDVI emissivity gated; no external NDVI file input or complete NDVI-assisted LST path. Sentinel-1 parser/SAR helpers exist but no dedicated validated native radar tool. Preserve these facts and intended LST requirement in PLAN-0015 r4; no runtime change authorized during consolidated discussion.
